title: Kim Jong Un to Mickey Mouse in three real photos?
description: Three real photos connect North Korea's Kim Jong Un to Mickey Mouse, through two American presidents.
hook: How is Kim Jong Un connected to Mickey Mouse?

image.file: File:Kim and Trump shaking hands at the red carpet during the DPRK–USA Singapore Summit.jpg

links.line: In 2018, Kim Jong Un shook hands with Donald Trump in Singapore, the first summit between their two countries.
Back in 1987, real-estate developer Donald Trump met President Ronald Reagan at a White House reception.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan and Nancy Reagan during a trip to Orlando, Florida and a visit to Epcot Center at Disney World and a group photograph with Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse - DPLA - 5810c0c969617ab7f42e1b068ba08dca.jpg

links.line: And in 1985, after cold weather cancelled his inaugural parade, Reagan held it at Epcot, with Mickey Mouse.
